result.topic_en: Euler locates the value of x at which the parabola's supposed minimum property first fails, finding x ≈ 221/121 by solving a cubic, and then begins a general treatment in which the parabola must pass through two given points F and H.
result.transcription:
20
§. 8. Cum igitur minores valores pro $x$ assumti cum indole minimi consentiant, majores vero dissentiant, inquiramus in limitem, quo dissensus incipiat, seu ubi fiat $(2a+x)\sqrt{x-a}=a\sqrt{a}+x\sqrt{x}$, quod quo facilius fieri possit sumamus $a=1$ et $x=tt+1$, ut habeatur aequatio $t(tt+3)=1+(tt+1)^{\frac{3}{2}}$, ideoque $(1+tt)^{\frac{3}{2}}=t^3+3t-1$, et sumtis quadratis erit:
$t^6+3t^4+3tt+1=t^6+6t^4-2t^3+9tt-6t+1$, sive
$3t^3-2tt+6t-6=0$.
Ponatur $t=\frac{s}{3}$, ut prodeat haec aequatio: $s^3-2ss+18s-54=0$, hinc fit proxime $s=\frac{30}{11}$, ergo $t=\frac{10}{11}$, hincque $x=\frac{221}{121}$. Unde patet, ante quam $x$ sumatur $=2$, dissensum incipere.
Tab. I. Fig. 3. §. 9. Quo autem haec generalius evolvamus, curvam inventam ita instruamus, ut per data duo puncta F et H transeat, statuendo $Ff=f$, $Hh=h$, intervallum vero $fh=2g$, ita ut, bisecto hoc intervallo in $g$, sit $fg=hg=g$. Quaeritur ergo tam positio axis parabolae quam ejus vertex E. Hunc in finem sit ut supra $AE=a$ et distantia $Ag=v$, ita ut sit $Af=v-g$ et $Ah=v+g$. His positis, si in aequatione nostra inventa $y=2\sqrt{ax-aa}$ sumamus vel $y=v-g$, vel $y=v+g$, esse debebit vel $x=f$, vel $x=h$, unde nanciscimur has duas aequationes: $v-g=2\sqrt{af-aa}$ et $v+g=2\sqrt{ah-aa}$, ex quibus valores tam pro $v$ quam pro $x$ elici debent. Eliminato

items.quote: inquiramus in limitem, quo dissensus incipiat, seu ubi fiat $(2a+x)\sqrt{x-a}=a\sqrt{a}+x\sqrt{x}$
items.english: Let us investigate the limit at which the disagreement begins, i.e. where $(2a+x)\sqrt{x-a}=a\sqrt{a}+x\sqrt{x}$ holds.

items.quote: Unde patet, ante quam $x$ sumatur $=2$, dissensum incipere.
items.english: Hence it is clear that the disagreement begins before x is taken equal to 2.

items.quote: curvam inventam ita instruamus, ut per data duo puncta F et H transeat ... Quaeritur ergo tam positio axis parabolae quam ejus vertex E.
items.english: Let us arrange the curve found so that it passes through two given points F and H ... Thus both the position of the parabola's axis and its vertex E are sought.
